title: Distortion of countably branching diamonds from midpoint and tree energies
summary: We derive quantitative distortion bounds for countably branching diamond graphs from midpoint estimates and direct tree energies. In the dual of a finite-height segment forest, every distortion- D embedding of the depth- k diamond satisfies $`D^2\ge1+k/4`$. The same bound holds in the infinite-height coordinate predual. We also obtain power-type distortion bounds for path-cost and recursive tree norms.
family_title: Reflexive midpoint convexity and diamond distortion

review.reason: Derives distortion bounds for countably branching diamond graphs via midpoint and tree energies.
